decisions.quote: An association between a polymorphic ApaLI site within the porphobilinogen deaminase (PBGD) gene and schizophrenia has been reported recently. In order to replicate this finding we examined the ApaLI RFLP, which is located in intron 1 of the PBGD gene, in 93 unrelated patients who met the DSM-III-R criteria for schizophrenia versus 74 unrelated controls. There were no significant differences between the groups in allele frequencies or genotype counts.
decisions.reason: Prior adjudication and state files are absent. The blind target has empty bibliographic fields solely because the supplied source text for Nöthen et al. (1993) is abstract-only and describes the recently reported association between the polymorphic ApaLI site in the porphobilinogen deaminase (PBGD) gene and schizophrenia without printing a citation. That single retested original finding is already represented by shipped row 1510 (Sanders et al., January 1993, Schizophrenia Research, 'Association between genetic variation at the porphobilinogen deaminase gene and schizophrenia', 10.1016/0920-9964(93)90019-f).
